items.title: Experiment tests whether AI models can detect concepts injected into their own activations
items.summary_en: Quanta Magazine reports on research in which Jack Lindsey of Anthropic injected concepts directly into a model's internal activations to test whether the model can notice and describe them. According to the report, the models could at least sometimes detect and describe the injections, and other researchers then repeated the experiment on open-source models. Whether this counts as real introspection is likely still debated.
